## Leaders on the record:   Impact that delivers

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/christus_logo_testimonial.svg)

We chose Leena AI because of their willingness to work with us on complex use cases across our information systems. The solutions they presented clearly stood out compared to others we evaluated. Our go-live was seamless, with smooth integrations into SharePoint, Infor, our Learning Management System, and ERP. Today, our users enjoy a consistent experience no matter where they interact with their AI Colleague. We’re excited to see what comes next.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/Testimonial/christus_avatar.webp)

Chris Dickerman

Director, Workforce Experience

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/mckinley_logo_testimonial.svg)

We were sunsetting ServiceNow and needed an HR helpdesk live across 70+ properties in five weeks, for on-site employees who needed answers fast on their phones. Leena AI soft-launched a week ahead of plan and exited hypercare with zero blockers. Kinley, our AI Colleague, has been live in Teams, iOS, and Android since day one. A cutover like this lives or dies on ownership, and Leena AI showed up with the urgency the moment required.

![](https://leena.ai/images/podcast/mercedesSullivan.webp)

Mercedes Sullivan

EVP People, Culture & Communications

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/cocacola_logo_testimonial.svg)

AskArwa has transformed how we resolve tickets. Turnaround across HR, IT, and finance has gone from 2 days down to 6 hours, and the employee experience is noticeably better. It's also given us a reliable way to reach 100% of our employees digitally, something we hadn't been able to do before.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/Testimonial/cocacola_avatar.webp)

Makeen Khan

Chief Information Officer

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/fm_logo_testimonial.svg)

We were looking for a solution for ticketing. What we found was that most others added AI on top of their systems, whereas Leena AI was built as a native AI solution. Initially, success for us meant getting the right case to the right person. But after exploring what Leena AI could do, we redefined success as avoiding the creation of unnecessary cases altogether. Leena AI showed us we could resolve over 70% of questions in real time for our global workforce, and that was very intriguing to us.

![](https://leena.ai/imagesV2/Testimonial/fm_avatar.webp)

Michael Manning

VP, HR Data & Innovation

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/mongodb_logo_testimonial.svg)

We chose Leena AI for its strong integrations with SAP and our broader tech stack. They demonstrated use cases that closely matched what we needed, and the pace of innovation over the last two years showed clear alignment with our vision of reducing complexity, boosting efficiency, and driving measurable ROI. Most importantly, we wanted to avoid creating tickets that should never have existed in the first place, and Leena demonstrated that in their demos/PoC.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/hira_monogoDB.webp)

Hira Hashmi

Sr Director, People Operations

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/testimonial/beacon_logo_testimonial.svg)

People are at the heart of everything we do at Beacon Mobility. We wanted to free up time so our people could have more human-to-human interactions, it was just natural to involve AI Colleagues in that journey. We loved Leena AI's passion and values. It aligned with who we are and who we wanted to be. We turned on password reset and on day one, 49 people used it, before we'd even rolled out training.

![](https://assets.leena.ai/images/cutomers_testimonials/judith_beacon.webp)

Judith Crawford

Chief Executive Officer
